### [`unused_cf71`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_cf71.asm#L6) `$CF71-$CF7F`

*data*

Nothing reads these bytes: 14 zero bytes and $ff. $cf80-$cfa1 is not in the program. Build V 05 05 87 has the $00/$ff RAM fill pattern at $cf20-$cfff.
